description:
Does not load. dyld aborts at startup because required system libraries are missing.

**Tested with:** darlinghq/darling commit `362b6a1f400ce0be97a14f1a85b422f851a22d66`, built natively on aarch64 Linux with Metal enabled, run in rootless mode via the staged launcher. The game binary is arm64-only (Feral Interactive macOS port, version 1.3), downloaded with DepotDownloader and unmodified.

**Result:** dyld aborts (exit code 134):

    dyld: Library not loaded: /System/Library/Frameworks/BackgroundAssets.framework/Versions/A/BackgroundAssets
      Reason: image not found

**Missing libraries** (from a static check of everything the binary links, so only the first one is confirmed by a run):

- `BackgroundAssets.framework`
- `CryptoKit.framework`
- `/usr/lib/swift/libswiftDispatch.dylib`
- `/usr/lib/libate.dylib` (Apple Texture Encoder; the game imports 4 functions from it)

CryptoKit and libswiftDispatch look like Swift overlays that weren't built because I had no Swift toolchain. Other required frameworks (Metal, AppKit, WebKit, etc.) exist, but whether they work is untested.

**Details:** https://github.com/darlinghq/darling/issues/2215 ,On the VibeDarling fork the same game gets further and only misses `libate`: VibeDarling/darling#1671.
